reason: The facts check out, but half the finding is low value and the timing fix has almost no margin. (1) Ledger: tools/runtime_ledger.py does take the family from the FIRST exp token. Tested: 'probe 51: exp70g + K + CI = exp87a' is filed as safetail, while 'probe 51: exp87a = ...' and 'probe 51: exp83c = ...' are filed as safetail_ci. But every -m since probe 34 already starts 'probe N: expX = ...', and CONTEXT l.1964 already requires this. The ledger is report-only ('nothing here FAILs'), and --family REF=safetail_ci repairs a misfile after the fact. So this half is an existing convention, not a new risk. (2) Timing is the real issue. Amendment A still says 'latest 14:00Z'. 14:00Z + 9.45 h = 23:27Z, against the W4 freeze at 23:30Z. The proposed 13:30Z cutoff rests on ONE hidden CI run (exp79a, L (9.27, 9.45] h). The ledger shows a ~0.9 h spread in L within the K2 family: 6.87 h (exp78a) to 7.81 h (exp70q). CONTEXT (T) still logs a CI band of 9.4-10.9 h. At 13:30Z + 10.2 h the read lands at 23:42Z, and at + 10.9 h at 00:24Z; both miss the freeze. So 13:30Z has about zero margin under our own spread. Probe 50 can also turn terminal from ~11:54Z (05:02:30Z + 6.87 h), earlier than the finding's 12:03Z. The dummy times (exp87a 1,870 s, exp83c 2,055 s vs exp79a 1,712 s) are lane noise and do not predict a longer hidden run: exp81 SEC ran 1,250 s, below exp70g's 1,409 s. Probe 51 is the 5th and last submit of 28 Sep, so a late or mislabelled submit cannot be redone. Direction confirmed: pre-register an earlier cutoff.
fix: Append one pre-score line to CONTEXT before 50 is terminal: 'PROBE 51 TIMING (amends amendment A 'latest 14:00Z')'. (a) -m starts 'probe 51: exp87a = exp70g (cap 6) + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 + coordinject ALPHA 0.5 MAX_UM 3.0 ...' under R+, or 'probe 51: exp83c = exp70g + n2a SEC + coordinject ...' otherwise. Re-run tools/runtime_ledger.py right after the submit and check that the family column reads safetail_ci. If it does not, pass --family <ref>=safetail_ci. (b) Hard cutoff 13:00Z, not 13:30Z. 13:00Z + 10.2 h = 23:12Z; 13:00Z + 10.4 h = 23:24Z. If 56629533 is not terminal at the 13:00Z header, go with R? (exp83c, dummy PASS 3d1d738176cd). Submit within one poll of 50's terminal header. (c) Start wake-ups at 11:50Z (50 can be terminal from ~11:54Z), then 12:20Z, 12:50Z and 13:00Z (cutoff). Pause the feed and watch loops ~10 min before the submit. Use the usual pre-submit checks (poll header < 15 min old, not a 429, no duplicate, 4 used today). (d) If 51 is still PENDING at the 23:30Z freeze, code it R?-like for W4 (not scored, so it is not dropped, and never resubmitted), and log its L with the CI-RAN rule when it lands.
realistic_gain: Process only, no score effect. The fix makes it much more likely that probe 51 reads before the 23:30Z W4 freeze: at 13:00Z there is ~20-70 min margin across the plausible L 9.3-10.4 h, against ~0 margin at 13:30Z and a likely miss at 14:00Z. That keeps the non-additive-stop and SEC read usable for the 3 night slots, and it keeps the ledger's R5 and insertion-gate lines right for a CI file. The labelling half adds almost nothing beyond the existing convention.
